status.title: Wanted! Monty Mole
status.build: Development sprite overlay, five optional trainers
status.software: 1,093,053 ULA checks. 0/249,911 figure differences. 137/29,261 intervals over budget. Room 19 scenery differs.
status.next: Resolve scenery outside the figure, remaining frame deficits and the independent crusher timing difference.

functional.scope: 249,911 figure comparisons and 1,093,053 ULA comparisons across five recordings. Synthetic coverage of all 30 callers.

integration.scope: Final NXC started from the OverSpec menu. All 32 fix-on and 32 fix-off loader combinations checked.

timing.scope: 137/29,261 modelled intervals over budget. JNext crusher Y diverged at update 38.

display.scope: OverSpec outside and mine captures. The replay proves one settled wrong scenery pixel in room 19.

hardware.scope: No physical Spectrum Next or NextTang run.

techniques.target: Apply the retained-ULA concept to an OR plot with destructive rectangle writes. The XOR composition predicate does not hold.
Save and restore IFF at all MMU hooks.
Return the original programmed clock after all MMU hooks.

results.evidence: 0 of 459 updates equal. Removing this call changes game state.

results.evidence: All 29,504 ULA and 6,285 figure comparisons matched. Zero over-budget intervals in 459.

results.evidence: Pixel (134,51) has transparent sprite ink. The enemy changes the underlying attribute from 0x47 to 0x43. 486 cell/update observations in this recording survive until an update.

results.scope: 35 comparable play updates from the first indoor HALT
results.evidence: 1.456849 s original and 1.435597 s patched. Crusher Y first differed at update 38. Longest IRQ gaps 19.97 and 39.94 ms.
All 8 combinations of four starting speeds and two interrupt states pass.
All 8 speed/IFF cases restore clock and mapping.

results.check: Hardware sprite patterns, ULA and live state from original recording inputs
results.evidence: 1,093,053 ULA checks. 0 of 249,911 figure checks differed. Each recording detected a corrupted upload.

results.check: Hook time versus original HALT slack
results.scope: 29,261 measured update intervals across all five recordings

pacing.coverage: Original 2,000-frame benchmark and paired JNext runs from one indoor state.
pacing.result: The quick run meets 459/459 budgets. Full model exceeds 137/29,261. In independent play the crusher position first differs at update 38.

dependencies.coverage: Two completions and three scripted recordings reach 20/30 main caller sites. All 30 sites execute the shared hook in synthetic contexts.
dependencies.result: Replacing the visible screen by scenery changes 11 point tests. Skipping the actor update changes live RAM in 459/459 comparisons.

feasibility.decision: Keep original ULA bitmap and attributes. Colour hardware patterns from plot data. Enemy paint also affects scenery outside the figure.
feasibility.next_experiment: Resolve display correction outside figures. Check the room 19 witness and remaining timing deficits. Re-run live timing from the same indoor HALT before release.
